text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT — Elevated 5xx and timeout spike on service `runtime-api`. Canary deploy just finished (deploy id d-20260315-118). p95 jumped ~10x, p99 up to ~8s, 5xx rate +1.6% over baseline. Pager triggered (sev2). Runbook: https://redwood/runbooks/runtime-timeouts

sara: ack, oncall taking. pulling dashboards now — looking at per-region split, latency by route.

raj: seeing it too — p95 120ms -> 1.2s, p99 ~8s. Error rate concentrated on `/v1/generate` proxied requests. Errors look like `upstream timeout` + some `502` from gateway.

elaine: I just noticed the canary modified connection pool params for grpc-proxy. Pausing rollouts and preparing rollback.

deploy-bot: rollback command executed by @elaine: `infra deploy rollback --id d-20260315-118 --to d-20260314-305 --force --reason "p99 spike"`

deploy-bot: rollback initiated at 3337778895, progress: 60% (routing configs reverting).

tomas: traces from x-ray: majority of timeouts show long wait in `proxy->backend` connection acquire (~6s) then socket close. Backend pods in gp-rt-1 show increased `TIME_WAIT`. Possible connection saturation or ephemeral port exhaustion.

sara: customer impact: CS reported two enterprise customers with degraded responses on API calls. Estimated 2% of traffic affected, mostly heavy-token gen requests. Notifying affected accounts now.

raj: quick mitigation — toggling smart-routing fallback to `legacy-fast-path` pool for high-latency routes. Command: ```
curl -XPOST https://internal-api/routing/failover 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN" 
  -d '{"service":"runtime-api","from":"gp-rt-1","to":"legacy-fast-path","percent":100}'
```

elaine: failover applied at 3337778908, traffic shifted. p95 improving to ~300ms, p99 down to ~650ms. Error rate trending down.

incident-bot: rollback complete at 3337778912, deploy state: v1.9.2 active. Telemetry: p95 and error rate returning to baseline for most regions.

tomas: collecting logs and flamegraphs. Run: `kubectl logs -l app=runtime-api -n prod --since=15m > /tmp/runtime-logs-3337778915.log` and `perf record` on one affected pod. Uploading to S3: s3://redwood-ops/incidents/3337778888/

sara: handing off to raj for post-rollback monitoring. Oncall handoff notes: rollback completed, failover in place for critical routes, CS notified, follow-up actions listed below. I'll be available for 15m if needed.

raj: taking over. Immediate next steps: 1) diff canary change for connection pool (k8s config + sidecar proxy) 2) validate ephemeral port usage across nodes 3) add quick SLI guard to block rollouts that increase p99 >3x baseline during canary.

elaine: creating customer communication draft and a short status on status.redwood.com.

support-bot: created ticket INC-4821 for affected customers, linked to this thread and to CS notes.

raj: preliminary hypothesis: canary adjusted keepalive/tcp_reuse settings in combination with proxy sidecar update which reduced connection pooling efficiency under high concurrent prefix-cache workloads. Needs root cause next.

elaine: will open a postmortem and attach the diffs and perf artifacts. Action items: rollback safe-mode for canaries, add automated canary SLI check, escalate to infra-telemetry to add ephemeral port alerting.

incident-bot: sev2 -> monitoring. Recommend 2-hour bridge for deep dive if telemetry doesn't stabilize.

sara: thanks everyone — leaving summary in #incidents-log and will join the bridge if we get new signals. :thumbsup:

raj: I will follow up with a timeline and assign owners for the postmortem.

elaine: adding tests to CI to simulate high-concurrency prefix-cache workloads against canary config.

support-bot: customers notified; will escalate if additional accounts report impact.

incident-bot: thread closed for active mitigation at 3337778922 — will reopen if new alerts surface.
